method: Visual screening of all 1375 exported textures on 29 contact sheets, native-size checks of small atlases, and local Apple Vision OCR. OCR is candidate evidence, not acceptance.
limitations: Contact-sheet screening cannot prove the absence of subpixel text in every illustration; originals and OCR evidence remain available.
Font atlases and fictional-script graphics require font/renderer analysis, not ordinary texture translation.
Presence in game assets does not establish runtime reachability. Development/editor/engine and mockup groups require consumer checks before localization.
Equivalent textures in different containers retain every source ID even when gallery previews are grouped by exact decoded pixels.
